About

A small developmentstudio in Montréal.

Netfluence is Ryan Meziane and Kui Hua Wang. We design, build and host websites and software for local businesses.

Background

We both studied Computer Science at John Abbott College and started Netfluence in May 2024.

Most of our work is websites for local businesses: a fish market, an electronics sales agency, a shopping centre, a towing company and a marketing agency. Some clients also need custom software or an app, and we build those too. We host and maintain what we build.

Working with us

  • Who you deal with

    Ryan and Kui, directly. There’s no account manager in between.

  • Design

    You see and approve the page designs before we start building.

  • Testing

    We test on phones and in the major browsers before launch.

  • After launch

    We host and maintain what we build, and make changes when you need them.
